description: JavaScript functions for form validation, including setting requirements, length constraints, conditional validation, and HTML content validation.

methods.name: max_formSetRequirements
methods.description: Sets validation requirements for a form element, including validation type and description.

methods.name: max_formSetUnique
methods.description: Sets a uniqueness constraint for a form element based on a list of existing values.

methods.name: max_formSetLength
methods.description: Sets minimum and maximum length constraints for a form element.

methods.name: max_formSetConditionalValidate
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript condition to evaluate before validating a form element.

methods.name: max_formValidateElement
methods.description: Validates a single form element based on its set requirements and constraints.

methods.name: max_formValidate
methods.description: Validates an entire form, displaying alerts for errors and focusing on the first invalid field.

methods.name: getObj
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM object by ID, supporting different document models.

methods.name: max_formValidateHtml
methods.description: Validates the HTML content of a form element for proper tag nesting.
